title: A distant source and mass
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: Mass curves spacetime and can deflect light from a more distant source. The resulting distortions help astronomers infer the mass distribution of a foreground lens.

misconception: A learner may choose: A telescope lens manufactured in space
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: What is gravitational lensing?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: What is gravitational lensing? The deflection of light by mass along its path. Mass curves spacetime and can deflect light from a more distant source. The resulting distortions help astronomers infer the mass distribution of a foreground lens.
Visual caption: Mass bends light paths. The SVG is a conceptual illustration, not measured data or a scale model.

recall.question: What is gravitational lensing?
options: A galaxy switching off its light
The deflection of light by mass along its path
A telescope lens manufactured in space
recall.why: Mass curves spacetime and can deflect light from a more distant source. The resulting distortions help astronomers infer the mass distribution of a foreground lens.
